comparison.objective: Attach three tilted legs to an inverted stool and turn it upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Fixture stabilization, repeated angled attachment, collision avoidance, and reorientation.
comparison.success_condition: All legs are attached and the stool is upright; setup and scoring thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Multi-part furniture assembly does not specifically test preserving a calibrated screw under jam-nut torque and cycling a gripper mechanism.
